methods.note: The 3D steady Icepak/FLUENT, realizable k-epsilon setup is stated on pdf pages 3 and 5-7. The paper contradicts itself on the flow regime: Table 2 says 'Axisymmetric' and the assumptions list says 'Laminar flow', while the model is a 3D k-epsilon case. The extraction records this as a non-essential mismatch, but it means the solver description is not a consistent method. The case is 3D forced-air CFD, so it is not a 2D reproduction.

code.note: The packet lists no assets and the Data availability statement (pdf page 11) says no data was used. There is no code, repository, Icepak project or geometry file to verify. The extraction's checked_no_links status matches this, but nothing can be reproduced from code.

parameters.note: The chip size (2.2 x 2.2 x 0.1 cm), 8 W, 0.1 m/s, 298 K and 36 fins match Tables 1 and 3. The heat sink is 4x4x1.7 cm in Table 1 but 3x3.5x2 cm in the text. The fin is D=0.2 cm in Table 1 but radius 0.16 cm and height 1.5 cm in the text. The base height is 0.2 cm in Table 1 against a 2 cm third dimension in the text. Tin is 298 K in Table 3 but 295 K in the Fig. 9 discussion. Fin pitch, cabinet axis assignment and material properties are not given. No self-consistent parameter set exists.

config.note: The extraction's experiment has an empty floorplan and empty power_w, and the chip x/y position is null. The packet has no coordinates for the chip or heat sink, no block geometry file and no Studio configuration, so no same-scenario power-per-block mapping can be checked. The extraction claims Fig. 1 (c,d) has no coordinates, but only pdftotext output is in the packet, so that figure was not visually inspected.

data.note: The text-table values (Table 6: 126.97 C for IA circular, Table 3, Table 4, Table 5) are present in the extracted text. The decisive figures (Fig. 1, Figs. 6-12) are not supplied as images, so no digitization or visual verification was possible. The Rth value is not tabulated and there are no raw data. The Table 7 pressure drop has no unit. The temperature location is ambiguous: 'Source' in Table 6 versus 'fin base' in Eq. 8.

findings.reason: The experiment is labelled custom_2d_steady with an empty floorplan and empty power map, while the scenario is a 3D forced-air pin-fin CFD case and steady_2d_relevant is false. The label implies a 2D reproduction that the evidence does not support. The decisive 3D, airflow and pin-fin features cannot be reduced to 2D without invented effective boundary conditions.

The chip coordinates are null, so no floorplan block can be placed and per-block power cannot be tied to geometry. The assertion that Fig. 1 has no coordinates was not visually verified because no figure image is in the packet.

The paper contradicts itself (4x4x1.7 cm against 3x3.5x2 cm). The extraction records only the first value of each triplet, so the evidence rows are incomplete. The base height of 0.2 cm and the text's 2 cm are also inconsistent. No decisive geometry can be approved.
